name: Lomita City Council Meeting
agenda_text:
REGULAR MEETING OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
AGENDA
Tuesday, May 18, 2021 - 06:00 p.m.
LOMITA CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS
24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA 90717
Published by the Office of the City Clerk
1.
OPENING CEREMONIES
PURSUANT TO EXECUTIVE ORDER N-29-20 ISSUED BY GOVERNOR NEWSOM ON MARCH 17, 2020, THE PUBLIC AND COUNCIL MAY PARTICIPATE IN THIS MEETING VIA TELECONFERENCE.
Public comment will be accepted via email to ccpubliccomments@lomitacity.com prior to the meeting and before the close of oral communications. All comments will be read into the record.
The public may also participate in the meeting via a computer or smart device by logging into ZOOM at the following link: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/84653253969
You may enter your name when prompted do so. If you wish to provide public comment at either the beginning of the meeting or for a particular item, you may either (a) contact the City Clerk's Office before the meeting and provide your name or (b) utilize the "raise hand" option located under the participants name. Once you click on this option you will be in the rotation to make a public comment.
Please note, if you do not have the audio feature on your device you will need to call (669) 900-6833 and enter ZOOM Meeting ID: 846 5325 3969 then press pound (#). When prompted to enter the participation ID number press pound (#) again. To make a public comment enter "*9". The Clerk's office will be notified, and you will be announced to make a public comment.
Written materials distributed to the City Council within 72 hours of the City Council meeting are available for public inspection immediately upon distribution via the City of Lomita website or by contacting the Deputy City Clerk at l.abbott@lomitacity.com.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, you should contact the office of the City Clerk at (310) 325-7110 (voice) or the California Relay Service. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the City to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility to this meeting.
This meeting will be conducted in compliance with CDC guidelines and applicable orders of the Los Angeles County Health Officer.
a)
Call Meeting to Order
b)
Flag Salute
c)
Invocation – Mayor Waronek
d)
Roll Call
2.
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
3.
PRESENTATIONS
4.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Persons wishing to speak on Consent Agenda items or subjects other than those scheduled are requested to do so at this time. In order to conduct a timely meeting, a five-minute time limit per person has been established. Government Code Section 54954.2 prohibits the Council from discussing or taking action on a specific item unless it appears on a posted agenda.
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS AND MEETING ATTENDANCE REPORTS FROM THE CITY COUNCIL The City Council may discuss and act upon items described under Council comments; however, items which are not on the agenda will be limited to Council reports, announcements, requests for clarification or factual information, or placement of matters on the agenda for a future meeting.
6.
CITY MANAGER’S REPORT (information only)
7.
CONSENT AGENDA
All items under the Consent Agenda are considered by the Council to be routine and will be enacted by one motion in the form listed below. There may be separate discussions of these items prior to the time the Council votes on the motion. Specific items may be removed from the Consent Agenda at the request of any Council Member or staff.
RECOMMENDED ACTION: That Consent Calendar Items 7 a-n be approved.
a.
Motion to Waive Full Reading of Ordinances and that they be Read in Title Only
RECOMMENDED ACTION: Approve Motion.
b.
Minutes of the Regular City Council Meeting of May 04, 2021
RECOMMENDED ACTION: Approve Minutes.

c.

RECOMMENDED ACTION: Approve and file Warrants/Payroll Register.

RECOMMENDED ACTION: Receive and file the report.

RECOMMENDED ACTION: Receive and file the report.

RECOMMENDED ACTION: Receive and file the report.
Item 7h
i.
March 2021 Treasury & Investment Report
RECOMMENDED ACTION: Receive and file the report.
Item 7i
j.
Public Works Agreement with CS Legacy Construction, Inc. for the construction of Hathaway Park Restroom Upgrade Project (Sewer Connection)
RECOMMENDED ACTION: 1) Approve a total project budget of $118,689.20; 2) Award a Public Works Agreement to CS Legacy Construction, Inc. in the amount of $103,208.00 for the construction of Hathaway Park Restroom Upgrade Project (Sewer Connection); and 3) Authorize the City Manager and City Clerk to execute the Public Works Agreement.
Item 7j
k.
Agreement with Koff and Associates to complete a Classification and Compensation Study
RECOMMENDED ACTION: Authorize the City Manager to execute an agreement with Koff and Associates in an amount not-to-exceed $76,705 (which includes a 15% contingency) to complete a Classification and Compensation Study.
Item 7k
l.
Professional Services Agreement with Tripepi Smith for Website Redesign, Hosting, and Maintenance
RECOMMENDED ACTION: Authorize the City Manager to sign an agreement for a term of five (5) years with Tripepi Smith for website redesign, hosting, and maintenance.
Item 7l
m.
Letter of Commitment to Connect to the South Bay Fiber Network (SBFN)
RECOMMENDED ACTION: Authorize the City Manager to sign a letter of commitment to connect to the South Bay Fiber Network (SBFN) for two additional sites – Lomita Park and the Cypress Water Production Facility (CWPF).
Item 7m
n.
Lease Agreement with the Roman Catholic Archdiocese of Los Angeles for 200 acre-feet of unused FY 2020-2021 Groundwater Pumping Rights
RECOMMENDED ACTION: 1) Approve a lease agreement with the Roman Catholic Archdiocese of Los Angeles for 200 acre-feet of unused FY 2020-2021 groundwater pumping rights at a price of $100.00 per acre-foot for a total of $20,000; and 2) Authorize the City Manager and City Clerk to execute the agreement.
Item 7n
SCHEDULED ITEMS
8.
DISCUSSION AND CONSIDERATION TO APPROVE A PROFESSIONAL SERVICES AGREEMENT WITH CDM SMITH FOR THE STORMWATER PROJECT FEASIBILITY STUDY
Presented by Carla Dillon, Public Works Director
RECOMMENDED ACTION: 1) Approve a Professional Services Agreement with CDM Smith for the Downtown Multi-Benefit Stormwater Project Feasibility Study in the amount of $102,000 plus a 10% contingency amount of $10,200.00; and 2) Authorize the City Manager and City Clerk to execute the Agreement.
Item SCH 8
PUBLIC HEARINGS
9.
DISCUSSION AND CONSIDERATION TO ADOPT THE 2020 URBAN WATER MANAGEMENT PLAN
Presented by Carla Dillon, Public Works Director
RECOMMENDED ACTION: 1) Conduct a public hearing for public review and receive comments on the Water Shortage Contingency Plan (WSCP); 2) Adopt resolution 2021-11; 3) Conduct a public hearing for public review and receive comments on the 2020 Urban Water Management Plan (UWMP); 4) Adopt resolution 2021-12; and 5) Direct Staff to:
a.
Incorporate the public’s comments if any and make changes (as necessary) and approve and adopt the 2020 Urban Water Management Plan and its recommendations.
b.
Submit the 2020 Urban Water Management Plan to the State of California Department of Water Resources as required.
Item PH 9
10.
ADJOURNMENT The next regular meeting of the Lomita City Council will be held on Tuesday, June 1, 2021, at 6:00 p.m.
